_comment: Every authenticated-only route (signed-in workspace member, no @RequirePermission) must be declared here with the reason it is safe. Key = 'file' (all routes of the controller) or 'file#handler'. 'review': 'documented' = the reason comes from the code's own comments or the owner's spec, not yet proven by a test of this audit; 'tested' = covered by a dynamic test in apps/api/test/e2e/authz; 'decision' = needs a human policy answer (listed in the report). Never add an entry to silence the check without reading the handler.

infra/providers/chat-conversations/media.reason: short-lived signed token bound to one person and workspace; visibility rule re-checked at read time (AUTHZ-064/074)

modules/addons-extension-registry/addons.reason: installed-add-on list shown in the shell to every member (read-only catalogue of this workspace)

modules/google-account/google-consent.co.reason: confirming a Google connection: the service accepts only the signed-in person who pressed Connect, in the same workspace (a forwarded link is refused and withdrawn); the grant is stored once, on that confirmation

modules/admin-console-shell/shell-user.c.reason: the caller's own shell state: config, tour flag, quick access, announcements, overview tiles

modules/admin-console-shell/shell.contro.reason: navigation layout resolved from the caller's own permissions

modules/admin-console-shell/workspace-se.reason: Reference gates General / notification / Data & export to the workspace OWNER, not a permission key; the service checks ownership on every read, write, export and delete (non-owner gets 403)

modules/auth/auth.controller.ts.reason: session, workspace list and switch act on the caller's own session; switch must verify live membership (AUTHZ-016/017/027)

modules/auth/controllers/account.control.reason: the caller's own profile, password, MFA, passkeys, sessions; deleteAccount must refuse the last owner

modules/auth/controllers/impersonation.c.reason: impersonation state of the caller's own session; start/stop are operator-side and covered by impersonation guard rules

modules/auth/controllers/registration.co.reason: verification mail for the caller's own address

modules/coupons-credits-referral-currenc.reason: the caller's own referral overview, list and export (pinned to the caller in the service)

modules/marketing-site-cms/workspace-cms.reason: live announcements and help articles shown to every member; the helpful-vote is one changeable vote per user

modules/notifications/notifications.cont.reason: the caller's own notification feed and preferences

modules/notifications/push.controller.ts.reason: the caller's own browser push subscriptions, pinned to the caller in the service

modules/plans-subscriptions-trials/billi.reason: plan picker, entitlements, status and usage are readable by every member (Reference: Authenticate only). DECISION: billing status and usage figures visible to non-billing roles (AUTHZ-062)

modules/plans-subscriptions-trials/plans.reason: plan catalogue shown on upgrade prompts; changing the plan needs plan.subscription.manage

modules/team-chat/team-chat.controller.t.reason: checked per action in the service from the member's tchat.* capabilities and channel membership (AUTHZ-036/040)

modules/workspaces-teams-tenancy/members.reason: member directory every workspace member can open (Reference shows it to any signed-in member); every write is gated

modules/workspaces-teams-tenancy/teams.c.reason: team directory every member can open; every write is gated

realtime/ticket/realtime-ticket.controll.reason: mints a one-time realtime ticket for the caller's own session; every room is authorised again at join
